data.name: Hilton Istanbul Bomonti
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Rooms with Panoramic Views
Experience the elegance of Hilton Istanbul Bomonti with spacious rooms offering breathtaking views of the city or Bosphorus. Enjoy the luxurious furnishings, air conditioning, and floor-to-ceiling windows in every room. Upgrade to an Executive room for exclusive access to the Executive Lounge and indulge in a residential feel with top-notch amenities.

Culinary Delights and Dining Experiences
Savor a variety of international cuisines and Turkish specialties at The Globe restaurant. Treat yourself to hot and cold mezzes made from high-quality ingredients. Unwind at the Executive Lounge on the 34th floor with a stunning view while enjoying continental breakfast and evening buffets.

Relaxation and Wellness
Indulge in relaxation at Eforea Spa with an indoor pool, sauna, Turkish hammam, and fitness center. Pamper yourself with spa treatments and private facilities for couples. Don't miss out on the outdoor pool and hairdresser services for a complete rejuvenating experience.

Book your stay at Hilton Istanbul Bomonti now for an unforgettable blend of luxury, culinary delights, and relaxation.

data.name: Conrad Istanbul Bosphorus
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation with Bosphorus Views
Experience the ultimate luxury at Conrad Istanbul Bosphorus with its upscale suites and contemporary designed rooms offering breathtaking views of the Bosphorus. Each room is elegantly furnished with modern amenities, ensuring a comfortable stay.

Gourmet Dining and Rooftop Bar
Treat your taste buds at Manzara Restaurant, where you can enjoy Mediterranean delicacies while taking in panoramic views of the Historic Peninsula and Bosphorus. For a more laid-back experience, head to Summit Bar&Terrace on the 14th floor for a wide selection of beverages and appetisers with stunning city and Bosphorus views.

Leisure and Business Facilities
Indulge in the hotel's leisure facilities including open clay tennis courts, spa, fitness centre, Turkish hammam, and indoor/outdoor pools. With business facilities and meeting rooms available, Conrad Istanbul Bosphorus caters to both your relaxation and professional needs.

Book now for an unforgettable stay at Conrad Istanbul Bosphorus and immerse yourself in luxury and comfort.

data.name: Radisson Blu Hotel Istanbul Ottomare
data.hotelDescription:
Unique Architecture and Sea Views
Experience the charm of Radisson Blu Hotel Istanbul Ottomare's unique architecture and breathtaking views of the Marmara sea from the comfort of your room. The modern design in soft tones creates a distinctive atmosphere perfect for a memorable vacation.

Luxurious Amenities
Indulge in the high-quality amenities offered at the hotel, catering to both leisure and business travelers. From the seasonal outdoor pool and sun terrace to the indoor pool and spa facilities, relaxation and comfort are guaranteed throughout your stay.

Culinary Delights and Convenient Location
Start your day with a delicious open buffet breakfast and savor exquisite dishes in the elegant dining room or enjoy drinks and snacks at the on-site bar. Conveniently located near the sea and just a short distance from Istanbul Airport and the historic Sultanahmet district, Radisson Blu Hotel Istanbul Ottomare offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience.

Book your stay now at Radisson Blu Hotel Istanbul Ottomare for an unforgettable experience by the sea.

data.name: Crowne Plaza Florya Istanbul by IHG
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Amenities
Crowne Plaza Florya offers an indoor and seasonal outdoor pool, spa, wellness centre, and hammam. Guests can also enjoy free WiFi, private parking, and a children's pool for the little ones.

Dining Experiences
Indulge in a variety of culinary delights at Salamina Restaurant, Atrox Restaurant Lounge, Sardinia Winter Garden Restaurant, and Orca pool bar. From breakfast to international cuisine and snacks, there's something for every palate.

Convenience and Accessibility
With a fitness centre, garden, terrace, and services like private airport transfers, concierge, and 24-hour front desk, Crowne Plaza ensures a comfortable stay. Plus, its proximity to Istanbul's top attractions and transportation hubs makes exploring the city a breeze.

Book now for a memorable stay at Crowne Plaza Florya!

data.name: Sura Hagia Sophia Hotel
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Ottoman-Style Architecture and Peaceful Botanic Garden
Sura Hagia Sophia Hotel, located in Sultanahmet, features traditional Ottoman-style architecture, an outdoor swimming pool, and a serene botanic garden with various flower species. Enjoy the tranquil ambiance and beautiful surroundings during your stay.

Comfortable and Well-Equipped Rooms
Experience a calm and quiet atmosphere in soundproof rooms equipped with modern amenities such as air conditioning, LCD TV, and a fully stocked minibar. The private bathrooms come with complimentary toiletries and slippers, ensuring a comfortable stay.

Gourmet Dining and Relaxation Options
Indulge in a rich buffet breakfast and savor Ottoman cuisine at Deraliye Restaurant. Unwind with a cup of coffee in the peaceful garden or at Khaldi Café. Pamper yourself at the spa facilities with Turkish bath and massage sessions, or stay active at the fully-equipped fitness center.

Experience luxury and relaxation at Sura Hagia Sophia Hotel. Book your stay now for an unforgettable experience.
